statement: On 160 grid tasks (seed grid/velocity) and 6175 components, the evaluation matrix scored the same 1000 genomes at 1,710,044 evals/s against 10.910 evals/s for real grid cells ticked in a Brain, a ratio of 156,748x against an aim of 100x (met); the two paths disagreed on 0 task outcomes, claims, counts or fitnesses across those genomes, and the audit recomputed all 988,000 matrix cells in real cells with 0 mismatches. On a synthetic landscape whose optimum is known, the ruler at patience 200 reported the generation the optimum was first held with a max error of 0 generations (tolerance 0) and ended holding the planted set on 16 of 16 fresh seeds with the directed engine (directed 0.75, optimum first held at generation 18..146), while the undirected engine on the same seeds did so on 16 (generation 140..464) and stopped early on 0; at patience 20 the directed engine was on time on 10 and stopped early on 6. Infinite mode fired on 8 of 8 planes of a finite list and ran 655 planes of an unbounded list until its 20000 ms budget ended (stop: wall), carrying a best of 158/160 (union bound 159); the best library solved 110/160 of a fresh draw. The organism-years printed are declared arithmetic, never a measurement, and all wall numbers were taken on a machine shared with other processes. Bar met.

development.what: the grid suite of tasks/grid.mjs at the run seed: the matrix, the genomes, the exactness check, the audit and the infinite planes all use it

heldOut.what: the fresh draw of the same families at <seed>:heldout, never searched: the best library is scored on it and printed; it is not part of the bar

split.contaminated: the rate, exactness and audit parts of the bar are measured on the searched suite itself; only the printed fresh-draw score is held out

years.arithmetic: 262023 evaluations x 2022.448 ticks each (measured on the tick path) x 0.001 s/tick (declared) / 31557600 s/year = 1.679240e-2 organism-years (declared arithmetic, not a measurement)
19123342 evaluations x 2022.448 ticks each (measured on the tick path) x 0.001 s/tick (declared) / 31557600 s/year = 1.225567e+0 organism-years (declared arithmetic, not a measurement)
5184 ticks run x 1 s/tick (the plane's declaration) / 31557600 s/year = 1.642710e-4 organism-years (declared arithmetic, not a measurement)

machine.shared: other processes (other builders of the same board) were running on this machine during the run; every wall number is a contended number
